fit_reason: Whole 2003 VW Golf GTI offered by a private seller on Facebook Marketplace.
findings: Heavy dust and debris coating the instrument cluster lens and dash area in the odometer photo
Yellowed, hazy headlight lenses visible in the front three-quarter shots
Dark blue paint looks flat and dull on the hood and side panels, with little reflection
Hood shows uneven, blotchy finish in the front-facing photo
Black lower bumper grilles and trim look faded and grayish on the front bumper
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the GTI. In the photos the headlights look pretty yellowed and there's a good layer of dust on the gauge cluster and dash. We do pre-sale details that come to you, including headlight restoration and a buff to bring some depth back to the blue paint. Would you like a quote?
